review.summary: No new bugs, regressions, security issues, missing required tests, documentation gaps, or scope violations were identified in the corrected committed TASK-057E diff. Local and release manifests preserve migration gating, worker isolation and backend image identity; the standalone entrypoint registers its ORM foreign-key dependency; automated lifecycle and PostgreSQL coverage plus the completed local browser record support the task criteria. Coolify-provider behavior and production deployment remain explicitly unavailable or out of scope rather than claimed as passed.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: The testing guide now specifies a nonzero migration-container exit and dependent-service startup prevention, and explains why the harness reads the service exit directly.
The QA follow-up now records the successful human rerun of browser item 2 and no longer contradicts the dated manual results table.
